meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 为项目添加 GitHub 频道：复制适配器代码、注册通道、安装依赖并验证构建。配置后，代理能参与 PR 和 issue 评论线程，在被 @提及 时回复并持续跟进后续评论。
howto.when: 当你想让代理参与 GitHub 的 PR 或 issue 评论时触发。需先创建机器人账号、生成凭证并设置 webhook。

say.text: 帮我集成 GitHub 频道，让代理能回复 PR 和 issue 评论。
say.note: 会执行添加 GitHub 适配器的完整步骤。

say.text: 把这个仓库的 GitHub webhook 配置好，用机器人账号。
say.note: 会提示你输入 token 和 secret。

say.text: 给项目添加 GitHub 支持，使用 per-thread 会话模式。
say.note: 按技能步骤安装、接线并设置会话模式。

howto.what_en: Adds GitHub channel integration: copies the adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds and validates. The agent then participates in PR and issue comment threads, replying when @-mentioned and following up on subsequent comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add GitHub integration or configure a GitHub channel. Requires a bot account, fine-grained token, webhook, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Integrate GitHub channel so the agent can reply to PR and issue comments.
Set up the GitHub webhook for this repo using the bot account.
Add GitHub support with per-thread session mode.
say_en.note: Installs, wires, and configures sessions per the skill.
